name: Bamberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bamberg (Saint George with shield and banner on red).
history: Municipal flag of Bamberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bamberg arms — Saint George on red
